title: 第4章 柴房密谈苟道真谛初悟第3章 寿元暴涨痴傻伪装避锋芒
slug: 长生从假死开始万年之后我还在
content_zh:
柴房藏锋，苟道开局
夜风卷窗，枯叶贴纸微颤，转瞬被劲风扯飞无踪。
昏暗柴房内，陈默依旧蜷缩在稻草堆中，头颅深埋，呼吸匀净绵长，形同沉眠。
唯独眼睑之下，瞳孔极轻一转，精光暗藏，洞悉门外一切动静。
碎石路面传来沉稳步履，不急不缓，毫无遮掩，直指柴房而来。
咔哒。
锁芯轻响，木门被推开一线。
清冷月光斜劈入房，照亮一袭纤尘不染的白袍下摆，一缕高级青云檀香随之漫溢。绝非宗门统一配发的廉价香火，是内门顶尖弟子才有资格使用的珍稀香料。
李慕白负手立在门口，垂眸俯视蜷缩的陈默，唇角噙着一抹居高临下的凉薄笑意。
“倒是命硬，居然没死。”
语气轻佻，像在打量一条侥幸苟活、掉进泥坑的卑贱野狗。
陈默纹丝不动，肩头微微瑟缩，喉咙发出含糊的咕噜声，笨拙翻身朝向墙壁，疯癫呓语断续溢出：“别杀我……断龙崖有鬼……别砍我……”
“装？”
李慕白轻笑两声，抬靴尖，精准踹在陈默小腿骨上，力道不轻不重，带着刻意的羞辱。
“从万丈断龙崖摔下不死，还能独自爬回宗门，你跟我说你疯了？”
陈默浑身剧烈一颤，猛地弹坐而起，双眼空洞涣散，口水顺着嘴角肆意流淌，手指死死指着李慕白，神情惊恐痴傻：“是你！你要砍我头！你要杀我！”
李慕白嫌恶蹙眉，后退半步，抽出随身白绫锦帕，细细擦拭被泥水溅到的衣袍，动作矜贵，满眼鄙夷。
“果然是命格残缺，连带心智都是残次品。”
他语气冰冷轻慢，极尽嘲弄：“掌门仁慈，留你废命禁闭三日。等这场闹剧落幕，便将你逐出师门还俗，别留在玄霄宗污了山门清净。”
陈默置若罔闻，只反复低喃，状若惊惶本能：“我不想死……别杀我……”

李慕白盯着他空洞的眼神，审视数息，确认表面无半分破绽，随即俯身压低嗓音，字字阴寒：“知道我为什么非要你死吗？”
陈默歪头呆滞，神色茫然，一副全然听不懂的痴傻模样。
李慕白自顾自冷笑，道出缘由：“你命格诡异残缺，逆天苟活，引得雷云三次轰击护山大阵。于宗门而言，你就是祸根灾星。”
“我推你坠崖，不是害你，是为宗门除患。你这条苟活的贱命，该谢我才对。”
闻言，陈默忽然咧嘴，露出一口脏黄牙齿，笑容呆滞怪异，吐出一句含糊不清的话：“活得久……才是赢……”
李慕白瞬间一怔，随即嗤笑出声，满眼不屑：“赢家？”
“柴房四周遍布灵觉监视符，隔壁就是执法堂修士轮值打坐。你但凡调动一丝灵力，瞬间便会被镇压锁拿。”
他站直身躯，居高临下俯瞰，极尽碾压姿态：“你天生经脉漏灵，废体一个，修行终生难有寸进。我不出三年便可突破结丹，而你，一辈子困在练气底层，终生都是蝼蚁废物。”
陈默始终垂首低眉，藏在稻草中的指尖微动，不露分毫异样。
李慕白转身欲走，脚步一顿，回头看向他，笑意阴恻，补了一刀：“对了，柳如烟托我带话，昔日给你的辟谷丹，是她省吃俭用攒了三月的宗门份例。”
他刻意停顿，字字扎心：“可惜啊，你现在疯疯傻傻，连吞咽吃食都做不到，真是白白糟蹋了她的心意。”
话音落，李慕白抬脚踏出柴房，哐当一声，沉重落锁，脆响刺耳。
脚步声渐行渐远，彻底消散在夜色中，直至守夜弟子换岗的口令声遥遥传来。
刹那间，蜷缩在草堆的陈默，所有疯癫痴傻尽数褪去。
抬眼的瞬间，空洞涣散的眸子骤然澄澈冰冷，漆黑深邃，只剩彻骨寒凉与极致冷静。
他悄无声息挪至门边，耳膜紧贴木板，精准捕捉门外两道巡逻脚步往复两圈，直至周遭彻底死寂。
垂眸看向反绑的手腕，浸水的麻绳早已泡胀松弛。
他腕骨借力微拧，借着干草粗糙的摩擦力，紧实的绳结瞬间脱滑、松散、落地。
双手解禁，重获自由。
陈默抬手抚向后颈陈年旧疤——昔日练功所留的伤痕，此刻彻底平滑无痕。

寿元翻倍带来的逆天修复，不止修复体表重伤，更重塑了他全身根基、经脉、灵根底蕴。
他即刻盘膝坐定，闭目调息。
体内灵力奔腾流转，顺畅百倍从前。昔日淤塞凝滞的经脉被彻底拓宽贯通，所有修行桎梏尽数消散。
仅仅一周天运转，充沛灵力充盈四肢百骸，雄浑磅礴，远超从前巅峰。
content_en:
The front is hidden in the firewood shed, and the way to start is the beginning
The night wind rolled up the windows, and the dead leaf stickers trembled slightly, and were instantly torn away by the strong wind without leaving a trace.
In the dim woodshed, Chen Mo was still huddled in a pile of straw, his head buried deeply, his breathing even and long, almost like a deep sleep.
Only under the eyelids, the pupils turned very slightly, hiding their light, allowing them to understand all the movements outside the door.
Steady steps were heard on the gravel road, unhurried and unobstructed, heading straight towards the woodshed.
Click.
The lock cylinder rang softly, and the wooden door was pushed open.
The cold moonlight slanted into the room, illuminating the hem of a spotless white robe, and a wisp of high-grade Qingyun sandalwood overflowed. It is by no means a cheap incense distributed uniformly by the sect. It is a rare spice that only the top disciples of the inner sect are qualified to use.
Li Mubai stood at the door with his hands behind his hands, looking down at the huddled Chen Mo, with a condescending smile on his lips.
"It's lucky that he didn't die."
The tone was frivolous, as if he was looking at a humble wild dog that was lucky enough to survive and fell into a mud puddle.
Chen Mo didn't move at all, his shoulders trembled slightly, and he made a vague grunt from his throat. He turned awkwardly towards the wall, and his crazy words spilled out intermittently: "Don't kill me... There is a ghost on Broken Dragon Cliff... Don't chop me..."
"Pretend?"
Li Mubai chuckled twice, raised the toe of his boot, and kicked Chen Mo's calf bone accurately, with a force that was neither light nor heavy, and deliberately humiliating.
"You didn't die after falling from the Dragon Broken Cliff, and you were able to climb back to the sect alone. Are you telling me that you're crazy?"
Chen Mo trembled violently all over, and sat up suddenly. His eyes were empty and vacant, and drool was flowing freely from the corners of his mouth. His finger was pointed at Li Mubai, with a frightened and foolish expression: "It's you! You want to chop off my head! You want to kill me!"
Li Mubai frowned in disgust, took half a step back, took out the white silk brocade handkerchief he carried with him, and carefully wiped the robe that was splashed with mud and water, his actions were noble and his eyes were full of disdain.
"Sure enough, his destiny is incomplete, and his mind is also defective."
His tone was cold, scornful, and full of mockery: "The leader is kind and will keep you in confinement for three days. When this farce comes to an end, you will be expelled from the master and returned to the secular world. Don't stay in Xuanxiao Sect and pollute the purity of the mountain sect."
Chen Mo turned a deaf ear and only murmured repeatedly, as if in panic: "I don't want to die... don't kill me..."
Li Mubai stared at his empty eyes, examined him for a few breaths, and made sure that there was no flaw in the surface. Then he leaned over and lowered his voice, saying coldly: "Do you know why I insist on your death?"
Chen Mo tilted his head and looked blank, as if he didn't understand at all.
Li Mubai sneered to himself and explained the reason: "Your fate is weird and incomplete, and you are living in defiance of the heavens, causing thunder clouds to bombard the mountain guarding formation three times. As far as the sect is concerned, you are the bane of disaster."
"I pushed you off the cliff, not to harm you, but to eliminate trouble for the sect. You should be grateful to me for your miserable life."
Hearing this, Chen Mo suddenly grinned, revealing dirty yellow teeth. His smile was dull and strange, and he uttered an unclear sentence: "The one who wins is the one who lives longer..."
Li Mubai was startled for a moment, then sneered, with disdain in his eyes: "Winner?"
"There are spiritual surveillance talismans all around the woodshed, and next door are the monks of the Law Enforcement Hall who take turns meditating. If you mobilize even a trace of spiritual power, you will be suppressed and locked up in an instant."
He stood up straight, looked down from a high position, and expressed his overwhelming attitude: "You were born with leaky meridians and a useless body. It will be difficult for you to make any progress in your life. I will be able to break through the core formation in less than three years, but you will be stuck at the bottom of Qi training for your whole life, and you will be a waste of ants for the rest of your life."
Chen Mo always lowered his head and eyebrows, and his fingertips hidden in the straw moved slightly without revealing anything strange.
Li Mubai turned around to leave, paused, looked back at him, smiled sadly, and added: "By the way, Liu Ruyan asked me to tell you that the Bigu Pill she gave you in the past is an example of the sect that she saved for three months through frugality."
He paused deliberately and said, "What a pity. You are so crazy and stupid now that you can't even swallow or eat. You have really ruined her thoughts in vain."
As soon as he finished speaking, Li Mubai stepped out of the woodshed with a bang.The sound is heavy, crisp and harsh.
The footsteps gradually faded away, completely dissipating in the night, until the command for the changing of the guard for the disciples on guard came in the distance.
In an instant, all the madness and stupidity of Chen Mo, who was huddled in the haystack, faded away.
The moment he raised his eyes, his empty and distracted eyes suddenly turned clear and cold, pitch black and deep, leaving only bone-chilling coldness and extreme calmness.
He quietly moved to the door, his eardrums pressed against the wooden board, and he accurately caught the footsteps of two patrols outside the door, going back and forth twice until the surroundings were completely silent.
He lowered his eyes and looked at the wrists tied behind his back. The water-soaked hemp rope had already become swollen and loose.
He twisted his wrist bones slightly, and with the rough friction of the hay, the tight knot instantly slipped, loosened, and fell to the ground.
Unlock your hands and regain your freedom.
Chen Mo raised his hand to caress the old scar on the back of his neck - the scar from the past practice, now completely smooth and traceless.
The heaven-defying repair brought about by doubling his lifespan not only repaired serious injuries on the surface of the body, but also reshaped the foundation, meridians, and spiritual roots of his body.
He immediately sat cross-legged, closed his eyes and adjusted his breath.
The spiritual energy in the body is flowing freely, a hundred times smoother than before. The meridians that had been blocked and stagnated in the past were completely widened and penetrated, and all the shackles of practice were dissipated.
It only lasts for one day, and abundant spiritual energy fills the limbs and bones, making it majestic and majestic, far beyond its previous peak.
